mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50k over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market momentum, reducing corporate hiring costs and boosting profit margins, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales finance spending signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a risk-off re-pricing of equities and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in fewer than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals a looming recession and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) after two consecutive months of decline signals a recovery in consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.5% after two consecutive months of decline
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stagnant or declining federal funds rate signals a delayed monetary policy response, which increases real interest rate uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS unchanged or falling for 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in fewer than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS is flat or falling, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 4.3% and decline in payroll growth below 50k signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending power and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.5% annualized, combined with stable inflation, signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in fewer than 65% of instances during sustained GDP growth > 2.5%, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
